Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Basics Anti-Gravity Adjustable Recliner Chair, Gray
Colors: Gray
Materials: steel/fabric/plastic
Anti-gravity adjustable recliner with suspension seating and removable pillow Bungee cords through metal grommets secure durable outdoor fabric seat to lightweight, powder-coated steel frame No assembly required; offers infinite back and leg positions; 250-pound weight capacity; wide variety of colors Store during inclement weather; folds as compactly as a standard lounge chair; user manual included Measures 63.8 inches long by 26.8 inches wide by 29.3 inches high when opened
